rail.edit.hint: Type what you want to change
empty.title: Drop a photo here
command.placeholder: What do you want to change?
command.notUnderstood: I did not recognise that request. Try "remove the background" or "increase the resolution".
command.needsGenerative: That request needs a generative model, which is not in the catalogue yet. For now Nabu can remove backgrounds and increase resolution.
bubble.question: Want to do something with this?
refine.title: Refine the edge
refine.restore.hint: Paint back parts that were cut off by mistake
models.title: Local AI models
models.intro: Models are downloaded once and stay on your computer. Everything is processed locally: no image ever leaves your device.
models.desktopOnly: Models are managed from the desktop application. Start it with {command}: the backend is not reachable from a browser.
error.noImageOpen: Open a photo before editing it.
error.noBackgroundModel: No background-removal model installed. Download one from Settings → Models.
error.noUpscaleModel: No super-resolution model installed. Download one from Settings → Models.
backend.modelNotDownloaded: The model "{model}" has not been downloaded yet.
backend.downloadInProgress: A download is already running for this model.
backend.checksumFailed: Checksum verification failed for "{file}": the downloaded file does not match the expected one.
backend.sessionUnavailable: The model session is not available.
backend.unsupportedTask: Task "{task}" is not supported by the local engine yet.
backend.undecodableImage: The image could not be decoded.
model.lama-inpainting.description: LaMa generative model: removes objects and people from the photo, rebuilding the background realistically.
model.codeformer-face-restore.descriptio: CodeFormer generative model: restores and sharpens the features of blurred or damaged faces.
model.realesrgan-x4plus.description: Real-ESRGAN generative 4x super-resolution, rebuilding crisp detail on photos and graphics.
model.rmbg-1.4-quantized.description: Background removal from BRIA AI. Quantised build: about a quarter of the original size, slightly weaker on fine edges such as hair.
model.rmbg-1.4.description: Background removal from BRIA AI at full precision. Reference quality on fine detail.
model.isnet-general.description: A fully free-licensed alternative to RMBG, usable commercially. It is the default model of rembg.
model.swin2sr-lightweight-x2.description: Very light 2x super-resolution: a few MB, and fine on machines without a dedicated GPU.
model.swin2sr-classical-x2.description: 2x super-resolution with better quality than the lightweight build, at a higher computational cost.
model.slimsam-77.description: Compact SAM variant for click-to-select. Made of a vision encoder and a mask decoder.
model.dfine-nano.description: Finds and names the objects in the photo, so a request can say 'the person' or 'the red car'. Very light, and free for commercial use.
backend.noDetectionModel: No object-detection model is installed, so the photo cannot be read as a scene yet.
rail.move.hint: Drag to move around the photo
settings.title: Settings
settings.language.hint: Add your own translation by dropping a JSON file into the languages folder.
welcome.question: What do you want to do with this photo?
welcome.hint: or drag across the subject to select it
bubble.enhance.hint: Double the resolution of the whole photo
adjust.unavailable: This computer has no WebGL2, so adjustments are unavailable.
bubble.extract.hint: Isolate this object from the photo
error.noSelection: Draw around what you want to cut out first.
error.noSegmentationModel: No smart-selection model installed. Download SlimSAM from Settings → Models.
command.smart.hint: Understands free phrasing in any language
router.noChange: I understood the request, but there was nothing to change.
backend.routerUnavailable: This build has no language engine, so free-form requests are unavailable.
backend.routerNoTool: I did not understand which operation to run.
backend.routerInvalid: The request produced an operation Nabu cannot perform.
model.qwen2.5-1.5b-instruct.description: Understands a typed request in any language and turns it into an operation. It never edits the photo itself: it only chooses the tool and its settings.
resize.title: Resize image
resize.failed: The image could not be resized.
resize.enlargeNote: Enlarging resamples the pixels and softens the picture. To reconstruct detail, use Enhance instead.
